answer: Audits are recorded in reef, queued in relic, and harbor publishes the wait time. A farm of 330 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 53 identities per epoch. A farm of 1427 identities would post 1920 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
